scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: The film promises wallet privacy and no link between wallets through a magical coin-and-potion metaphor.
explains_well: Repeated watching eyes turn public visibility into a simple visual threat, then the wizard escapes.
unclear: There is no wallet interaction or explanation of how the user obtains privacy; the network and product mechanics remain unstated.
scenario: Hide the link between wallet activity through a privacy service.
product_clear_basis: The closing claim explicitly says there is no link between wallets.

lessons.keep: Repeat one emblem across object, story action and final brand mark.
lessons.avoid: Avoid making an absolute technical promise through fantasy alone.
lessons.open: Wallet behavior, network support, unlinkability, precise effects, asset origin and all audio remain unverified.
try: Use one Tin campaign card as the object in a short metaphor, then return to its actual approved state.
Pair a privacy metaphor with a plain before/after view of what information remains visible.

comparison.story: Make public visibility feel threatening. → Introduce a protector and ritual. → Represent the privacy transformation. → Suggest escape from observation. → State the promise and close the metaphor.
comparison.motion: Eyes multiply, the coin changes orientation, particles burst and a portal shrinks to a point. Exact paths and easing are unverified. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.
